title: Design class landing page: one highlight color, repeated inline pill and class cards
attribution_visible_in_image: Visible text: 'Defri Muhammad Fahrul Habiebi, Ruang Edit Founder' (a quote attribution), 'Copyright RE Production', 'Vivi Alfiani · 2024'. Not confirmed as the creator.
contains_third_party_content: 3D icon art and a character (origin unknown).

observed.layout: Warm off-white page with large soft blobs, blue asterisks and a lime sparkle. Slim nav (HOME, STORE, ABOUT US left; CLASS and an outlined lime pill 'CONTACT US' right). Bold all-caps headline 'LEVEL UP YOUR DESIGN [lime pill with arrow] WITH OUR DESIGN CLASS'. Left: 'With more than 2K+ MEMBERS, 500+ TUTORIALS'. Right: outlined lime 'Join us' with a circular lime arrow. A row of five rounded tiles (blue, charcoal, blue with a 3D character in the tallest center tile, charcoal, blue). A bordered container 'Our Classes' with three cards (Beginner, Expert, Employee), each with an arrow circle, divider, one line of copy and a 3D scene; the middle card is filled blue with a lime arrow. Closing statement 'KEEP [CREATING] UNTIL YOU FIND YOUR OWN AUDIENCE.' and footer.
observed.hierarchy: Headline, then the tile row with its center peak, then the class cards.
observed.typography: Bold geometric all-caps headline; clean sans body. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Glossy 3D icons, asterisk and sparkle glyphs.
observed.materials: Flat color blocks with glossy 3D assets; pill outlines.

implementation_notes: Inline pill-with-arrow inside the headline is repeated three times as a brand motif.
The middle class card is differentiated by fill to signal a recommended class.

concept_work.essence: A three-color system with lime reserved for action, and one repeated inline motif.
what_makes_it_work: Lime always means highlight or act.
The symmetrical tile row builds a clear focal peak.
A featured card is differentiated by fill.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Two competing top-level actions (Contact Us and Join us) share the same pill style.
Small grey copy on white measures about 4.29-5.21:1; footer text about 4.29-5.13:1.
Lime on off-white is a weak boundary.

links: Lime marks action across the nav pill, headline pill, CTAs and featured card.
The inline pill motif repeats in the closing statement.

pattern.name: Playful conversion page with one highlight color
must_preserve: One featured card differentiated by fill
adaptation_examples: Coding bootcamp: lime to brand orange, cards become tracks.
Photography workshops: charcoal base with a yellow highlight.

related.relation: marketplace hero with a single dark action
single hue family with reserved highlight

lessons: Reserve one color for action and use it everywhere an action appears.
Do not give two top-level actions the same visual weight.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Cobalt for structure, charcoal for contrast, lime reserved for 'highlight / act here', warm off-white ground.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: Offer, proof and class choices are clear.
A strong focal peak, controlled palette and playful assets.
Landing conventions are met: the headline states the offer and the sections are in a sensible order.
Two equal pills compete; 'Employee Class' is unclear; no hover or focus states shown.
Colors, pills and cards are applied consistently.
Toy-like 3D with a single highlight color is well executed but familiar for creator landing pages.

Scored on conservative values: primary text min 4.36:1; secondary text min 4.29:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True. Using best-estimate values the score would be 5; the measurement is within error of a threshold.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
